notes.title: [Version 4.0.8] vrm 1.0 support
notes.notes:
[h1][Version 4.0.8] vrm 1.0 support[/h1]

I updated VRoid SDK to v0.3.0 and UniVRM to 0.113.0.

And so, now VRM Posing Desktop can import vrm1.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/69b053d3fd09638cf86913c3d79aa99454b39012.png[/img]

[h2]Changes due to the UniVRM10 impact[/h2]

Due to MToon10 specifications, shadow color and appearance may differ from MToon when importing Series 0 models.

Related UniVRM issues.
* ShadeColor is not multiplying in MToon10
[url=https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2037]https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2037[/url]

* In VRM 1.0, I would like the influence from light sources to be the same level as the old Shader (VRM/MToon).
[url=https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2147]https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2147[/url]

Other changes compared to version 4.0.7 include

* Deleted the ability to limit the wind function's area of influence to hair only.

* When using the Save Camera Transform or Save Scene functions in previous versions, characters and Props will be flipped 180 degrees. I apologize for the inconvenience, but please re-save the scene or camera with the new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/a61473e5c196a9e3914c2c3dff15b6e28cc69aa2.png[/img]

[h2]Update Schedule[/h2]
I want to support VRM Animation format as pose, for which a draft has recently been released.

The update schedule is maintained at the following URL

[url=https://evelyngamedev.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=0730ec2c3c4e432fb9647e8495470641&pvs=4]https://evelyngamedev.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=0730ec2c3c4e432fb9647e8495470641&pvs=4[/url]

I hope VRM Posing Desktop will be useful for your creative activities.

notes.title: [Version3.4.8] Various changes to the Props System
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 3.4.8[/h1]
Thanks for using my app!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/9b045ac428b96e89f089cb0bd28b6798e81ae0b6.jpg[/img]

In addition to just refactoring the code, I have also implemented the following additional features

[list]
[*] Separation of Props selection and property operations
[*] Undo and Redo of Transform Gizmo
[*] Transform editing when UI is hidden
[*] Replace Props function
[*] Ability to hide Props
[*] blendshape slider for props(fbx/glb)
[/list]
etc.

[h1]Upcoming updates[/h1]

Upcoming updates

Next I plan to implement scene saving (restoration of characters and props).

Due to the Notion account transfer, the URL for the update schedule has changed.

https://evelyngamedev.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=0730ec2c3c4e432fb9647e8495470641

I wish you nothing but the best🙇

notes.title: [Version 3.3.4] Resolved an issue causing some users to crash
notes.notes:
I removed the cause of the crash by having the user who was experiencing the crash check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/fc63ee52d289a20eb9c9f3c85e82e20ea7ebaf6d.png[/img]

I had a very hard time because the crash did not occur in my environment, but I suspected that the performance improvement efforts made in version 3.3.2 had some negative impact.

So I reverted the source code to version 3.3.1 and implemented the "Unity animation clip export function" and "preset character changes" again.

I have already confirmed that it works correctly with the help of users who actually experience crashes.

It was a very hard work weekend.
Hope you have a good weekend.
